Name: Sector
Description: The sector that identifies the instance. Leave the slot empty, for example ExecuteInstanceFunction(,fn,{{result}}), to use the sector the function runs in; the slot itself must be present

Name: function
Description: The function that will be called in the instance

Name: Return
Description: The mustache that will be updated with the result of the function. Leave the slot empty to discard the result; the slot itself must be present because the engine reads it unconditionally

Name: Parameters
Description: The parameters that will be passed to the function
